name: Biped Mini
servos: 6× STS3215 (12 V) + 4× STS3032 (6 V, separate bus)
tagline: An earnest little guy who waddles, dances and waves.

wizard.prompt: Connect one servo at a time; Hangar Bay assigns the IDs in this manifest
Hold each joint at its marked zero and confirm
Place the body on a flat surface
Hold a hand 10 cm in front of each sensor
Hangar Bay drops the heartbeat; the body must go to its rest pose

buy.part: STS3215 / ST3215 serial bus servo, 12 V 30 kg
buy.notes: Get the 12 V / 30 kg version, not the 7.4 V one.
Some servos ship with a metal horn; check before buying.
Usually marked up on Amazon. Buy from an approved reseller at list price, with a 32 GB microSD.
Must be N16R8 (16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM).

buy.part: Serial bus servo driver / adapter board
buy.notes: TTL half-duplex adapter for ST/SC servos.
Standard (not wide) lens, plus a Zero-size FFC cable.
Rarely on Amazon. INMP441 boards on Amazon work as a substitute.
ST SATEL-VL53L8 board. A VL53L5CX board on Amazon is a close substitute.

buy.part: 3S Li-ion pack with BMS + balance lead

buy.notes: Multi-cell USB-C charger with power path.
DIP-switch selectable voltage; set to the value in the brief.
TPS2594x-class eFuse. A 10 A blade fuse plus MOSFET switch board works as a simpler alternative.

buy.part: Feetech STS3032 serial bus servo, 6 V 4.5 kg·cm
buy.notes: Hip roll and ankle roll. Runs on its own 6 V bus.

buy.part: 6 V / 5 A buck + second serial bus adapter
685ZZ bearings + M5 shoulder bolts + nyloc nuts
